verdict.rationale: Aider's docs say users can switch models mid-session with the in-chat /model command and can use local models via Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API; architect mode pairs two different models. Community reports confirm use with OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude 3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro, though one user hit a tokenizer error with an Anthropic model string. missing for 10: a first-party list of the supported cloud providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini are evidenced only by community posts), and documentation of provider/model configuration without friction such as the reported tokenizer error.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: During your chat you can switch models with the in-chat /model command.
Aider can work also with local models, for example using Ollama. It can also access local models that provide an Open AI compatible API.
Enter architect/editor mode using 2 different models.
The Claude APIs seem somewhat unstable, returning HTTP 5xx errors of various sorts. Aider automatically recovers from these errors with exponential backoff retries.
